Chapter 936: Chapter 3 Martial Tao Rankings (Subscribe Please)_2

But Lin Yuan?

A little fellow who has just stepped into the Eleventh Rank not long ago?

“The rule comprehension of the Galaxy Master should have surpassed us,”

the Void God Ultimate Being silently mused for a moment before slowly continuing.

At least the nine of them, as Ultimate Beings, were unable to create so many perfect rule models. Regarding the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule model, the nine Ultimate Beings had always been trying to establish it, but it was still far from perfection.

Yet now, in the Martial Tao First Tier Chapter, they saw an incredibly perfect model of the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule, which directly spanned from the First Realm to the Fifth Realm.

“Surpassed us?”

Xia Qin, the Ultimate Being, and the other Ultimate Beings exchanged glances, somewhat disoriented.

Although they had long recognized the potential of the Galaxy Master, believing Lin Yuan to be the strongest evolutionary genius in the history of human civilization, far surpassing them before they had stepped into the Twelfth Layer.

If Lin Yuan could successfully break through to the Twelfth Layer, he might soon become the second Twelve-Star human civilization has ever seen, just below the Xuanyuan Supreme.

And to go even further, he could directly surpass the Xuanyuan Supreme, becoming the most formidable Ultimate Being in human civilization.

But all this is predicated on Lin Yuan entering the Twelfth Layer.

Now that Lin Yuan is merely at the Eleventh Rank, his comprehension of the rules already surpasses that of these Ultimate Beings.

This was something none of the Ultimate Beings had anticipated.

The previous mental and spiritual will of Lin Yuan, when reaching the Twelfth Layer’s level, in the eyes of the nine Ultimate Beings, could still possibly be ‘a trick,’

perhaps due to some special events that led to a sudden increase in mental and spiritual will.

Even so, as Ultimate Beings, they still felt that Lin Yuan’s mental and spiritual will was only on par with them, not surpassing or dominating.

But now?

Establishing so many perfect rule models, especially the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule model, indisputably showcases the terrifying extent of Lin Yuan’s rule comprehension.

Unlike mental and spiritual will, there is no shortcut to rule comprehension; one can only comprehend by oneself.

…

“Nine Ultimate Beings, please make the final judgment on the Martial Tao Eleventh Tier Chapter…”

As the thoughts of the nine Ultimate Beings drifted, the voice of the Goddess of Wisdom rang out.

“The final judgment for the Martial Tao Eleventh Tier Chapter?” Xia Qin, the Ultimate Being, and the other Ultimate Beings steadied their spirits, contemplating seriously.

Without a doubt, the value of the Martial Tao Eleventh Tier Chapter was revolutionary, simply immeasurable.

Not to mention the crucial Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule model, just the other thousands of Pillar-level Fusion Rules alone would have an unprecedented impact on human civilization.

It should be noted that these rule models’ influence is not limited to Martial Arts Evolutionaries; evolutionaries of other paths can also comprehend them, although the effect may not be as pronounced as it is for Martial Arts Evolutionaries.

It can be foreseen that for countless millennia to come, the evolutionaries of human civilization will be influenced by the Martial Tao Eleventh Tier Chapter.

Even those who haven’t taken the path of Martial Arts Evolutionary will be able to purchase and observe it.

The influence of the Martial Arts evolutionary path will surpass that of the nine major ultimate evolutionary paths in one fell swoop.

After all, evolutionaries of the nine major ultimate evolutionary paths only make up one-tenth of the total evolving population of human civilization.

There are still a large number of evolutionaries who do not follow the supreme evolutionary paths.

Of course, this ratio increases with higher-tier evolutionaries.

Among Eighth, Ninth, and Tenth Rank Evolvers, four or five out of every ten are from the supreme evolutionary paths.

But even so, they are no match for the influence of the Martial Arts Evolutionary path.

The multitude of rule models in the Eleventh Tier Chapter can be utilized by any Evolver.

“Xuanyuan, what is your judgment?”

After repeated consideration, Xia Qin, the Ultimate Being, turned to look at the Xuanyuan Supreme.

The other seven human Ultimate Beings did the same; the value of the Martial Tao Eleventh Tier Chapter was too great, so vast that these Ultimate Beings dared not to make conclusions lightly.

“My judgment is…” Xuanyuan Supreme’s expression was solemn as he slowly declared, “One hundred trillion merit points.”

As these words were said,

the expressions of the eight Ultimate Beings varied.

The judgment of most Ultimate Beings was about fifty to sixty trillion merit points. How could Xuanyuan Supreme directly give a judgment of one hundred trillion merit points?

“One hundred trillion merit points?”

“Xuanyuan, you rate the Martial Tao Eleventh Tier Chapter so highly?”

Xia Qin’s face showed surprise; his own judgment of the Martial Tao Eleventh Tier Chapter hadn’t reached the terrifying figure of one hundred trillion merit points.

What is the concept of one hundred trillion merit points? Since the beginning of the Starry Sea Era, human civilization hadn’t seen such a vast amount of merit points being spent.

“Rating the Martial Tao Eleventh Tier Chapter so highly is also a high rating of the Galaxy Master.”

The Xuanyuan Supreme opened his mouth and then looked towards the other Supremes, “If none of you have any objections, we’ll proceed with this verdict.”

“No problem.”

“The value of Martial Arts Tier Eleven is worth this price.”

“Indeed.”

…

Xia Qin and the other seven Supremes nodded, having no objections.

“Nine Supremes, the final verdict for Martial Arts Tier Eleven is 10 trillion Contribution Points. Should this be converted into a corresponding ranking value for an increase?”

The voice of the Goddess of Wisdom continued to convey.

Ranking value is a judgment made by the three Goddesses according to the potential and popularity of each evolutionary path, among other factors, and is specifically used to rank within the evolutionary leaderboard.

The higher the ranking value, the higher the evolutionary path is ranked.

Of course, the ranking value is just internal data for the three Goddesses; only the nine Supremes are aware of it, and other evolutionaries do not know of this standard.

“Ranking value…”

The Xuanyuan Supreme paused for a moment and said: “We shall just follow the rules.”

The Xuanyuan Supreme was very clear on why the Goddess of Wisdom specifically raised this issue.

Because if the value of Martial Arts Tier Eleven truly reached 10 trillion Contribution Points, then the ultimate ranking value it received would surpass some of the supreme evolutionary paths.

Among the nine grand supreme evolutionary paths, there is also a ranking value, ranging between 8 trillion to 12 trillion.

…

Milky Way Main Star.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged.

After uploading Martial Arts Tier Eleven, Lin Yuan’s waiting time was much longer than the previous ten uploads.

But Lin Yuan was not surprised, as the contents contained within Martial Arts Tier Eleven were too vast.

Especially those rule models, which even the Supremes would need to spend time to verify and determine.

“Respected Tenth-Level Citizen Scholar Yuan, the Martial Arts Tier Eleven you uploaded has passed the final verdict…”

Suddenly, the solemn and serene voice of the Goddess of Wisdom rang out.

“It passed the verdict?” Lin Yuan’s face showed interest.

Even Lin Yuan guessed that the verdict of Martial Arts Tier Eleven was not led by the three Goddesses.

It must have the involvement of human civilization’s Supremes.

Lin Yuan was also quite curious about the Supremes’ reliance on Martial Arts Tier Eleven.

“The final determined value of Martial Arts Tier Eleven… is 10 trillion Contribution Points.”

The Goddess of Wisdom swiftly stated.

“10 trillion Contribution Points…” Lin Yuan let out a light sigh of relief.

Even though not long ago, Lin Yuan on his own had broken through an immensely large battlefield, securing a vast territory for human civilization, and had well intimidated the Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses…

The Contribution Points he ultimately obtained were just over two hundred billion.

But now, the value of Martial Arts Tier Eleven actually reached 10 trillion?

“Is it because of those rule models?” Lin Yuan had a notion in his mind.

If the Martial Tao evolutionary path is only applicable to Martial Arts Evolutionaries, but those rule models…

Could be used by any evolver, with an inconceivably high popularity.

This led to the explosive increase in the verdict of Martial Arts Tier Eleven.

Breaking through an immensely large battlefield, securing a massive territory for human civilization.

While it might somewhat enhance the civilization’s foundation, compared to the overall size of the territories, the foundation’s increase is ultimately limited.

But Martial Arts Tier Eleven is different; it’s not as simple as enhancing the foundation. It’s about instantaneously elevating human civilization’s foundation by several levels.

“So many Contribution Points… Based on the human civilization’s exchange rate of one Twelve-Star rarity equivalent to one hundred million Contribution Points… 10 trillion Contribution Points, would that be exchanged for one hundred thousand Twelve-Star rarities?”

Lin Yuan pondered silently.

One hundred thousand Twelve-Star rarities?

Perhaps all of the Twelve-Star rarities of human civilization combined wouldn’t amount to that much.

“Right, the ranking of the Martial Tao evolutionary path…”

Lin Yuan’s mind subtly moved as he remembered this matter.
